caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow basin with a wide rim and a central cylindrical holder extending vertically from its base. The basin is predominantly brown with hints of green and reddish tones lining the inside rim. Attached to the center of the basin, around the cylindrical holder, is a conical object, also brown in color, and a smaller, separate cylindrical ring or band, which appears to be leaning against the vertical holder. Metal clasps or loops are affixed to the basin edge and the band, possibly serving as handles or to attach components. The composition is simple and centered, with the objects set against an unadorned, light beige background.
title: Candle Holder
